policy.guid: First 128 bits of SHA-256(domain + canonical source GUID/version/flags/count provenance + all serialized package bytes after the 64-byte summary). Both object data and import/export/name tables are covered.
policy.generation: New derived GUID uses one generation whose export/name counts match the emitted package.
policy.formatVersion: 300 is the native format version, not a content release number; it should remain 300.
policy.revisionConclusion: Changed native SDCs/UTCs already receive different GUIDs. No additional manual content-version GUID bump is needed. Unchanged dependencies retain their exact GUID/bytes.
policy.newClassPackage: Compiled P2_PS2Objectives is new to this native publication; nonzero compiler GUID and generation structure recorded. It did not exist in native v1.
policy.limitations: Offline package-identity audit. Actual native remote-client negotiation is not claimed.
